name: Gasket
message: Sample creation on the kalleboda tiling — open it to regenerate live.

traversers.name: gasket
traversers.text:
max-split = 3
directive if visited@target == 0 always allow move
directive if visited-neighbors@target == 1 always allow move
move straight
move r1
move l1
move r2
move l2

name: Xor Diamond
message: Sample creation on the square tiling — open it to regenerate live.

traversers.name: walker_matt
traversers.text:
if ([A@e2] + [A@e2@e3] + [A@e2@e1] + [A@e2@e2]) % 2 == 1 then put A = 1
move straight

traversers.name: downer
traversers.text:
if ([A@e0] + [A@e0@e3] + [A@e0@e1] + [A@e0@e0]) % 2 == 1 then put A = 1
move straight

name: Sierpinski
message: Sample creation on the kalleboda tiling — open it to regenerate live.

traversers.name: sierpinski
traversers.text:
movement = absolute
max-split = 2
directive if visited@target == 0 always allow move
directive if visited-neighbors@target == 1 always allow move
if orientation == 2 and tile-type == wedge then move e7
if orientation == 3 and tile-type == wedge then move e7
if orientation == 0 and tile-type == wedge then move e5
if orientation == 1 and tile-type == wedge then move e4
if tile-type@e2 == wedge then move e2
if tile-type@e3 == wedge then move e3
if tile-type@e4 == wedge then move e4
if tile-type@e5 == wedge then move e5
if tile-type@e6 == wedge then move e6
if tile-type@e7 == wedge then move e7
if tile-type@e0 == wedge then move e0
if tile-type@e1 == wedge then move e1

name: Fern
message: Sample creation on the kalleboda tiling — open it to regenerate live.

traversers.name: fern
traversers.text:
max-split = 9
directive if visited@target == 0 always allow move
directive if visited-neighbors@target <= 1 always allow move
move straight
if steps % 4 == 0 and tile-type == octagon then move [e0, e1, e2, e3, e4, e5, e6, e7]

message: Sample creation on the kalleboda tiling — open it to regenerate live.

traversers.name: shape-maze
